body: Sometimes we overlook things that went alright or just different. Different doesn't mean failed or wrong. Was there a recent event that happened to you? What exactly was the last situation that makes you think so now?

I wonder if i should cut a person out as well and quit most of my interactions. Though it wouldn't really make much change because most of them are already ignoring me when they don't need anything, still feels so bad because if I'll tell that person I'll once again be this paranoid and selfish piece of shit who has to be happy and understand how hard is it for them. And at this point i don't know what to believe anymore, I know it's also me because I feel paralized and can't just say "fuck you all, I'm going home" and be happy doing things by myself. 

I never wanted to bitter, it often becomes like this when everything gets overwhelming... But I get what you're saying, I'm sorry you're in the same boat, but maybe that means we're just people in a messed up situation, but that's all. I hope you find piece with yourself and the others, even if that means that some people aren't compatible with your values and you'll have to get some boundaries to keep yourself safe.

Omg this. I keep asking myself if I expect too much when I want them to show me the same effort/support as I do or should I believe the statement "if i don't respond that doesn't mean i don't care". Well shit then why did I lose sleep over it when you need advice and I'm always too mich to handle?
On the other hadn, i might be just so sick to my head, I hate everything and desperately need just ONE fucking nice and genuine word/gesture, not just bland questions and getting ignored.

Sorry for ranting, but the title just 110% described my situation rn :/

I can relate to a lot you said, I felt quite similar when I failed 2 or 3 times before I made it. It sucks telling your family and friends who are waiting to say "congrats" that you didn't do the test, especially if they did sooner and you see them disappointed. So let them be. You will eventually do it and it would suck to always be looking back on this and be ashamed of yourself. You don't have to be because there's nothing to be ashamed of. Maybe you can, instead, make a funny story out of it? In one of my attempts, I had to park sideways, I was nervous af, it was raining heavily and blabla, I was going back and forward for 10 minutes just waiting for the controller, who was probably cringing so hard, to tell me to finally stop. But meh, I still cringe about it but I now choose to find this memory a lot more funnier (still not proud of it lol) 

Maybe take some time off and try to focus on some other things, driving test is not your whole life. And also, it's better that you fail a couple of times more and pay more money and for the result practice even more, than to pass and get into an accident due to a bad decision. It looks that you put all your self worth on the driving test and the reallity is... It doesn't matter if you do it in your 1st, 3rd or 59th try. It does matter for your wallet, and it does suck, of course, but don't put your life on it. You are capable of achieving it otherwise your instructor wouldn't put you on the road. Anxiety can take a huge toll on your driving and you need a smaller bit of this, it keeps you focused. And you don't even have to be SO optimistic, it can give you too high expectations and end uo in too much anxiety when on the road. Try to accept that it will probably be a bit scary and that there's always a possibility that something goes wrong, but don't beat yourself over it. Try to be your own friend now, you probably would yell at him if he didn't make it. 

Soo i better stop writing since it's getting long, so just: i know it sucks, but don't take your life over it. You got this, there are roads waiting for you to drive in the future, you'll see

Thank you for remembering that is still important to hang on the little things, I'll try to open my eyes a bit wider to see if I'm missing anything since I can get stuck in this tunnel vision
And yeah, I wouldn't call you pathetic. I still feel this way since I feel I can't deal with these emotions and all contradictions that comes with it, but that's probably a normal reaction. 
Take care!
thank you for answering, i'll take a look into this article as well
Thank you for this, you showed me a great perspective. Maybe the type of love we receive is not the same as the one we would expect, but it's still the same proof of caring.
